definition: to be in a difficult situation
description: A mirror selfie in a pink shop fitting room with a dark green velvet curtain on a gold rail. A young woman with long braids and gold hoop earrings wears a short silver sequin dress and holds up her phone, grimacing with clenched teeth as she twists one arm behind her back, unable to reach the zip; she gives up for a moment, touches her hair, then tries again. Other dresses hang on hooks on the wall, a round gold stool holds folded jeans and a tote bag, and sandals sit on the wooden floor.

de.answer: Sie macht ein Selfie mit ihrem Handy.
de.question: Was macht die Frau?

es.answer: Se está haciendo un selfi con el móvil.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer?

fr.answer: Elle prend un selfie avec son téléphone.
fr.question: Que fait la femme ?
